description: Simplify the midpoint highlighting logic in the editor to fix visual bugs and improve performance. The current implementation has unnecessary complexity that causes incorrect visual feedback when users interact with elements. We need to refactor the midpoint detection and highlighting system to be more reliable and efficient.
functional_requirements: Refactor the midpoint highlighting logic to remove unnecessary complexity and edge cases
Ensure midpoint highlights appear correctly when hovering over or selecting elements
Maintain or improve performance by reducing computational overhead in the interactive scene rendering
Update the type definitions to support the simplified midpoint highlighting system
Ensure the fix works consistently across different element types and interaction modes
